title: Charged after cancellation- be careful
body:
This service is extremely misleading.

Even after canceling my subscription, I was still charged. There is no clear visibility of active subscriptions, and billing seems to continue without proper user control.

This kind of behavior raises serious concerns about transparency and trust.

Be very cautious before using this service
